name: Linear
summary: Linear is a hosted issue tracker with customizable statuses, one assignee per issue, a triage inbox and links to GitHub and GitLab pull requests. The free plan allows unlimited members but only 250 issues and 2 teams. Paid plans cost $10 or $16 per user per month on yearly billing.

facts.text: New issues from integrations, from people outside the team, or created in the Triage view start in a Triage status. Accepting one moves it to the team's default status, and declining it sets a Canceled status type.
A team can require priority to be set before an issue leaves Triage, and triage rules can change an issue's status and priority automatically.
Each issue has one assignee at a time. Assignment can be automated, for example by auto-assigning the issue to you when you copy its Git branch name.

With the GitHub integration, an issue ID in a branch name, pull request title or commit message links the work, and linked issues move to In Progress when a pull request opens and to Done when it merges by default.
The GitLab integration links merge requests to issues and supports hosted and publicly accessible self-managed GitLab version 15.6 or later, but it does not import or sync GitLab issues.
SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning are listed on the Enterprise plan only. Google sign-in is available on every plan.
